
{{alias}}( N, hc, strideHc, offsetHc, out, strideOut, offsetOut )
    Converts a real-valued single-precision floating-point array in FFTPACK
    half-complex format to a single-precision complex floating-point array.

    The output complex array must have a length of at least `floor(N/2) + 1`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    N: integer
        Length of the original real sequence.

    hc: Float32Array
        Input array in FFTPACK half-complex format.

    strideHc: integer
        Stride length for `hc`.

    offsetHc: integer
        Starting index for `hc`.

    out: Complex64Array
        Output complex array.

    strideOut: integer
        Stride length for `out`.

    offsetOut: integer
        Starting index for `out`.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Complex64Array
        Output complex array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var N = 4;
    > var w = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float32}}( ( 2*N ) + 34 );
    > {{alias:@stdlib/fft/base/fftpack/float32/rffti}}( N, w, 1, 0 )
    <Float32Array>
    > var r = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float32}}( [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ] );
    > {{alias:@stdlib/fft/base/fftpack/float32/rfftf}}( N, r, 1, 0, w, 1, 0 )
    <Float32Array>[ 10.0, -2.0, 2.0, -2.0 ]
    > var out = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/complex64}}( ( N/2 ) + 1 );
    > {{alias}}( N, r, 1, 0, out, 1, 0 )
    <Complex64Array>[ 10.0, 0.0, -2.0, 2.0, -2.0, 0.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
